title: Data Flow Control in Master Mode

blocks.alt: Figure 30.5-3. Data Flow Control in GP-SPI Master Mode
blocks.caption: Figure 30.5-3 shows the data flow of GP-SPI in master mode. Its control logic is as follows:

c.v: bus is captured by Timing Module, converted in units of bytes by spi_mst_din_ctrl module, then buffered in spi_rx_afifo, and finally stored in corresponding addresses according to the transfer modes.
